Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: expedited pricing approval for GridWorks ELA (Q3 commit)

Hi Irene / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is aligned and we expect legal to move quickly if pricing is confirmed. We need a decision on the 15% concession on the first-year run rate to hit the number we discussed in the mutual action plan. If we cannot get approval by the end of day Friday (9/17) the customer has signaled they will delay signature until next quarter, which would push ~ $420k ARR out of Q3 into Q4.

Attached is the SOW with the line-item breakdown and the proposed concession highlighted. Can you confirm next steps and whether Deal Desk / Finance will accept a conditional commit in forecast while approvals are routing?

(Attachment: GridWorks_SOW_v3.pdf, PDF)

Hi Anna — appreciate the clarity and the SOW.

Quick notes:
- We can start a provisional entry in the forecast as a "conditional commit" but Deal Desk needs formal justification (reason, delta to list, and proposed term length). Finance prefers we reflect only the amount expected to be signed within the quarter; anything conditional must be marked and tracked.
- I’m looping in Marissa and Karthik from Deal Desk / Finance to triage. Please confirm the net ARR number after the concession and whether the term is 12 months or an ELA that extends beyond 12.

Action items (for GridWorks):
1) Confirm final line items and term length in the SOW (highlighted changes) — Anna
2) If possible, fill the short justification field in this DocSend link: https://docsend.com/view/gridworks-ma-v2 — helps Deal Desk accelerate review

I’ve attached a short triage checklist we use internally to speed approvals. I’ll ask Deal Desk to aim for a decision by 9/16 so we can update the forecast before week’s close.

Best,
Irene Choi

Irene — I’ve reviewed the SOW.

Summary / proposed handling:
- Customer asks for 15% concession on year-1 run rate; list price would be $375k, concession brings net to $318.75k.
- Risk: if we do not finalize by 9/17, commit likely slips to Q4 (~$420k impact to Q3).

Internal plan:
1) Marissa will open a Deal Desk review ticket with the attached justification and route to Pricing Committee.
2) I’ll mark the CRM opportunity as "Conditional Commit — Pending Pricing Approval" and set forecast flag so FP&A knows to treat as provisional.
3) If Deal Desk requests a smaller concession (e.g., 10%), we will prepare a counter offer and document expected ARR delta.

Please see my inline note to Anna below.

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Deal Desk met this morning. Outcome below and next steps for forecasting: 

Outcome:
- Approved concession: partial. Deal Desk approved a capped 10% concession on year-1 if GridWorks signs the ELA within 7 business days of receiving the revised terms.
- If GridWorks requires the full 15% we will need elevated approval from Sales Leadership and a one-time finance escrow hold; timeline for that path is ~72 hours extra.

What I changed for the forecast today:
- We will record a conditional commit net ARR of $337,500 (10% concession on $375k list) in the weekly forecast as "Conditional — Approved by Deal Desk, awaiting signature."
- If signature is NOT returned by EOD 2027-09-20 we will move the opportunity out of Q3 guidance and adjust the model.

Action items / links:
1) Irene / Jordan: please confirm you want the 10% path captured as provisional in CRM now — I’ve updated the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7830
2) Anna: I’ve attached the revised terms (GridWorks_approved_terms_v2.pdf) and started a DocuSign envelope — please review and sign. (DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123)
3) Kar: Finance will reflect the provisional $337,500 in the weekly reporting workbook; we’ll keep a live sheet for any movement.

(Attachment: GridWorks_approved_terms_v2.pdf, PDF)

Thanks — appreciative of the quick follow-through everyone. Small ask: once signed, please mark the HubSpot deal stage to "Closed — Won" and notify FP&A so we can lock ARR in the forecast.

Best,
